title: Use Group IV – uses subject to additional conditions
previewText: For uses denoted with a “P” in Section 22-141 (Use Group IV – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. In all Residence Districts, energy infrastructure equipment shall comply with the enclosure and screening provisions of Section 26-50 (SPECIAL SCREENING AND ENCLOSURE PROVISIONS).
